SOC 49-9021

Heating, Air Conditioning, and Refrigeration Mechanics and Installers by metro

Among Austin, Chicago, and Seattle, Heating, Air Conditioning, and Refrigeration Mechanics and Installers have a published OEWS May 2025 annual median of $80,100 in Seattle, the highest in this slice. Published medians: Seattle $80,100, Chicago $77,960, Austin $60,820.

Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. bls.gov/oes. These figures are informational republications of BLS OEWS. They are not legal, career, or hiring advice.
